title: 5 Brightwater, Crosshaven, Myrtleville, Co. Cork
description:
EMAIL ENQUIRIES ONLY. TO APPLY FOR THIS PROPERTY PLEASE SEND YOU NAME, PHONE NUMBER AND ANY DETAILS YOU MAY WISH TO PROVIDE THROUGH THE DAFT EMAIL. 

We welcome Tenant CVs from HomeHak.com as applications for this property. Shortlist this property in your HomeHak account if you would like status updates.

Absolute Property Management is delighted to offer to let this superb three bed fully furnished semi detached house . Situated in the picturesque sailing village of Crosshaven the property  is located in the desirable Brightwater development just a short stroll to the seafront. The property offers an abundance of bright living space and is finished to a very high standard. 

Accommodation includes an entrance hallway, sitting room, kitchen / dining room with fitted units and appliances, plumbed utility, three bedrooms with master en-suite and two bathrooms. Gas central heating. Front garden with driveway and side access to the rear garden. Bus service close by.
